posts.cooked:
Sidekick 1.2 for Android has been published to Google Play and Amazon, and will be available once it filters through their respective processes.

Here's what's new:

  • Official Sentinels of the Multiverse® high resolution card artwork for all Enhanced Edition Heroes, Villains, Environments, and target cards.
  • Fixed a problem where the randomizer would not select promo villains.
  • Many other small bug fixes and improvements.
 
We're already at work on other features including notes. Hope you guys enjoy the update =)

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked: With Android we had a chance to re-organize the artwork packs in a way that makes more sense. On iOS it ended up a bit more of a mish mash because we built support for it bit by bit. On Android it will be more straightforward. Sidekick includes all Enhanced Edition artwork at high resolution, including target cards. The artwork for expansions will be available in a future update as downloadable art packs. So you'll be able to get the artwork just for the expansions you own. Those with only EE right now have a complete Sidekick experience on Android including high resolution and target cards, which would be a separate download on iOS.

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
Android news! Version 1.3 is now available on Google Play and should be available from Amazon Appstore soon (there's a review process there).

This version adds more important features to continue bringing the Android version closer to the iOS version.

  • Flip villains from front to back, automatically adjusting their HP where applicable.
  • Heroes and other character cards can now become incapacitated.
  • Keep text notes on any target card during gameplay for basic effect tracking.
  • Tap and hold to change HP continuously.
  • New settings to show all heroes in portrait (tablet only) and change the order of target cards.
 
And before anyone asks: Vengeance is next!
 
 
A big thanks to our beta testers for continuing to help test the app! We couldn't do it without you.

OMG Sidekick update!

Android is now at version 1.4 and includes support for Vengeance - villains, heroes, and environments! Plus, it includes nemesis icons for all decks in the game & expansions.

![](upload://nSVlt0mQ1SkKMge9ntUNxKliIrV.jpeg)

iOS is now at version 2.3.2 - a tiny update that just contains The Super Scientific Tachyon promo card. 

Up next for Android is downloadable artwork packs. We'll have more details about those soon.

Later on, we'll be adding support for Wrath of the Cosmos and associated items of course. And iOS will be getting some more love; we've had some great feedback and suggestions from people and want to make those improvements. For now we're really focused on the video game, but we'll get back to Sidekick in time!
